cohort: 585 singleton pregnant women at term undergoing IOL at the University Hospital of Modena between January and December 2020.
finding: IOL for non-evidence-based indications leads to a longer induction to delivery time compared to IOL for PROM, both in nulliparous and multiparous women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was significantly influenced by Bishop score in nulliparous women and by gestational age in multiparous women.
